contentPattern: One row per card. Cell 1: photo. Cell 2: rich text - H3 heading, short description and a text link ('Mais informações') to a detail page. Photo renders on top; three per row on desktop with a staggered vertical offset per column; no card background.
reuseGuidance: Use for sets of 2-3 photo cards (photo on top, heading, description, text link to a detail page) without a card panel. For filled feature panels with a small icon use cards-feature; for stacked link rows use cards-links.
usageDescription: Row of three staggered photo cards ('Mais facilidades' on /nu/cartao), each linking to a /nu/cartao/* detail page.
